implementation_constraints: reads complete stdin as one expression
prints exactly one result line: integer value or ERROR
exits with status 0 for both success and errors

unresolved_intent.decision: Allow repeated unary minus operators, such as --3 and - -3.
unresolved_intent.rationale: The grammar includes unary minus and does not forbid nesting unary expressions; recursive unary parsing is the deterministic extension.

unresolved_intent.decision: Reject adjacent complete expressions, such as 1 2 or 2(3), as stray trailing tokens.
unresolved_intent.rationale: The contract says stdin is one expression and stray tokens are errors, so parsing must consume all non-whitespace input.

unresolved_intent.decision: Implement truncation toward zero with integer arithmetic using absolute-value floor division and sign restoration.
unresolved_intent.rationale: Using float division could lose precision or overflow for large integer literals; pure integer arithmetic preserves deterministic behavior.

unresolved_intent.decision: Treat any non-ASCII digit operator/parenthesis/whitespace character as an invalid token.
unresolved_intent.rationale: The specified grammar only names integer literals and the listed ASCII operators and parentheses; unsupported characters cannot be parsed.
